welcome:title: The world missed you
welcome:title__note: Headline for a user returning after a week or more. Warm, and about US missing THEM — never about what they failed to do.
welcome:body: {days, plural, one {It's been a day} other {It's been # days}}. Everything you learned is still here.
welcome:body__note: Reassurance on return. The second sentence is the important one: returning users fear their progress is gone.
welcome:kept.title: Still yours
welcome:kept.title__note: Heading above the counts a returning user keeps.
welcome:kept.facts: {count, plural, one {# fact learned} other {# facts learned}}
welcome:kept.facts__note: How much knowledge the user still has. Framed as kept, never as decayed.
welcome:kept.countries__note: How many countries the user has met.
welcome:due.some: {count, plural, one {# fact is ready for review} other {# facts are ready for review}}
welcome:due.some__note: What is waiting. 'Ready for review', never 'overdue' — the scheduler slipping is not the user's fault.
welcome:due.none: Nothing is waiting. Start wherever you like.
welcome:due.none__note: Shown when nothing is due. Never a dead end.
welcome:start: Pick up where you left off
welcome:start__note: Primary button. Continues rather than restarting — a returning user has not lost their place.
welcome:later__note: Secondary action that dismisses without starting a lesson. A returning user who is not ready to study must not be trapped.
